paite: Huaiziak in ginna ziak a siamtansak a om in i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan in Pathian toh kilem in i om uhi.
heading: Pathian Toh Kilemna
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

paite: Amah tawn mah in ginna in hiai hehpihna ah luttheihna i nei ua; huai a ding in Pathian thupina i tan ding lametna ah kipak in i om uhi.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

paite: Huai kia leng hilou in, i gimthuakna ah leng kipak in i om uh, gimthuakna in thuakhatna atun hi.
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;

paite: Thuakhatna in hindan hoih atun a, hindan hoih in lametna atun chih thei in.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

paite: Huan lametna in ahon zahlaksak kei a, huai Kha Siangthou i kiang ua hon piak tawn a Pathian itna i lungtang ua sun a a-om tak ziak in.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

paite: I hat louh lai in ahuntak in Pathian limsakloute sih sik in Khrist ahong sita hi.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

paite: Midik sik a sih, mi a-ut ngel kei hial ding ua, mihoih sik in bel mi kuahiam bek in sih angap khamoh kei ding hi.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in mikhialte i hih lai a Khrist i sik a asihna ah ahon itna alangsakta hi.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

paite: Huchi in asisan a siamtansak a i om khit nung in, amah ziak in Pathian hehna a kipan hotdam in i om ngei ding uhi.
heading: Pathian Hehna A Pan Hotdamna
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

paite: Melma i hih lai a bawn a Tapa sihna ziak a Pathian toh na kilemkik khin i hih ngal uleh, kilem a i om khit nung un ahinna ziak in hotdam in i om sem ding uhi.
english: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

paite: Huai kia leng ahi kei, kilepkikna tua hon musakpa i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak in Pathian ah leng i kipak ahi.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

paite: Huan mi khat ziak in khovel ah khelhna alut a, khelhna ziak in sihna alut a, huchi in mi tengteng akhelh tak ziak un sihna in mi tengteng azelsuakta hi.
heading: Adam Ziak A Sihna Khrist Ziak A Hinna
english: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

paite: Dan om ma in khovel ah khelhna a-om khin ngal a; dan a-om louh lai in khelhna tuh khelhna a sim ahi kei hi.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

paite: Himahleh Adam om a kipan Mosi om pha in Adam tatlekna bang a thil hihkhialloute tung ah leng sihna in vai ahawm zel hi. Adam tuh hong pai dingpa tehpihna ahi.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

paite: Himahleh thilthawnpiak zaw tatlekna toh akibang kei. Mi khat tatlekna ziak a mi tampi asih ualeh Pathian hehpihna leh mi khat, Jesu Khrist hehpihna thawnpiak akichingzaw sem a mi tampi tung ah vuh in a-om hi.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

paite: Huan thilthawnpiak zaw mi khat tatlekna gah toh leng akibang sam kei hi. Mi khat tatlekna tung a vaihawmna in siam louh tansakna atun a, mi tampi tatlekna tung a thilthawnpiak in bel siamtansakna atun hi.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

paite: Mi khat tatlekna ziak a sihna in huai mi khat mah pansan a vai ahawm leh hehpihna kiningching mahmah leh diktatna thawnpiak tangte'n mi khat, Jesu Khrist pansan in hinna ah vai ahawm zaw sem ding uhi.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huan mi khat tatlekna in mi tengteng a ding a siam louh tansakna atut mah bang in, mi khat diktatna thilhih in mi tengteng a ding in suahtakna leh hinna ahon tun hi.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

paite: Mi khat thumanlouhna ziak a mi tampi mikhial a bawl ahih bang un, mi khat thumanna ziak in mi tampi midiktat a bawl ahi ding uhi.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

paite: Khelhna latsak semna ding in Dan ahong om behlap a; himahleh khelhna akhanna peuh ah hehpihna akhangsem,
english: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

paite: huchi a khelhna in sihna a vai ahawm mah bang a, hehpihna in leng i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan a diktatna ziak a tangtawn hinna dong a vai ahawmtheihna ding in.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
